runs.summary: Checked all 41 tracked programmes on official pages. Key changes: Paderborn CE now requires GRE or dMAT; Saarland needs IELTS 7 + GRE/GATE; TU Delft CESE needs IELTS 7.0/6.5 + GRE and 2027/28 tuition is €26,479; TU/e Embedded Systems requires CGPA 8.5/10 for India (below 7.67); WHZ deadline moved to 30 Apr 2027; JEMARO has no 2026–28 intake; Twente/TU/e 2027/28 tuition published. Added Bremen CMM, TU Ilmenau RCSE, RWU EEES, Uppsala Embedded Systems and Linköping Electronics Engineering. Still unconfirmed: UiO (site blocked), Chalmers and Halmstad fees, TUM RCI tuition, Paris-Saclay fee exemption, EIT/SSI2 2027 dates.

Re-checked all 46 programmes on official pages. Changes: UiO deadline is 1 Dec (not 15 Nov); Twente EE/Robotics non-EU deadline confirmed 1 May 2027; RPTU has a €60 fee; TU Ilmenau €75 fee and dates confirmed; RWU confirmed; TUM RCI needs GRE Q≥164 and IELTS 6.5 (possible German requirement); THD flags a passed 15 Sep dMAT-proof deadline; Groningen 2027/28 fee €24,900. Added Stuttgart INFOTECH, FAU Autonomy Technologies, MDU Intelligent Embedded Systems, Mid Sweden Electrical Engineering and TUHH Microelectronics. Still unconfirmed: Chalmers and Halmstad fees, UiO fee, TUM RCI fee tier, Hannover (site unreachable), SSI2/EIT/Grenoble 2027 dates.
